old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-jzx5","title":"Tunnel-auth root binding space mismatch: coap_server sender_iid (address IID through eui64_to_iid XOR flip) can never equal main.c root_iid (pubkey_to_iid U/L-cleared) — all root grants deny WRONG_ROOT","description":"Found during utw0 verification (b7z9.35(b) wiring landed in ce47b0db12). MECHANISM: coap_server.c:648-653 derives sender_iid by extracting s6_addr[8..16] and applying lichen_eui64_to_iid, which XORs the U/L bit (ipv6_addr.c:170-171: iid[0] ^= UL_BIT) — a transform documented for MAC/EUI-64 inputs. LICHEN key-derived link-local addresses embed U/L-CLEARED pubkey IIDs (lichen_pubkey_to_iid ipv6_addr.c:180-181 clears; make_link_local embeds as-is), so the flip yields the U/L-SET form: sender_iid = pubkey_iid XOR 0x02 in byte 0. main.c:193-198 binds ctx-\u003eroot_iid = lichen_key_pubkey_to_iid(self.public_key) — U/L-CLEARED. tunnel_auth.c:343 memcmp(oscore_sender_iid, ctx-\u003eroot_iid, 8) therefore never matches for an authentic root posting over a key-derived link-local: every grant is denied LICHEN_TUNNEL_DENIAL_WRONG_ROOT. Fail-closed (no security hole: authorization ultimately rests on the COSE signature + kid check at tunnel_auth.c:345-346), but the feature is dead-on-arrival for real grants. The host test cannot catch it: tests/tunnel_auth/src/main.c passes root_iid directly as sender, bypassing the sockaddr extraction path. NOTE: coap_oscore.c:421-427, coap_keys.c:143-144 (keys_peer_eui64_from_addr), and coap_dtn.c all use the SAME extract+flip and are self-consistent because context creation keys oscore_ctx_get_by_eui64 with the same derivation — the tunnel ctx root_iid is the odd one out. Related: project-LICHEN-3ffq (docs gap on the same XOR). FIX SHAPE (for the fixer to adjudicate): either bind root_iid through the same sockaddr-space derivation (apply lichen_eui64_to_iid after pubkey_to_iid in main.c, or compare flip-normalized at tunnel_auth.c:343), or derive sender_iid via lichen_pubkey_to_iid-from-OSCORE-context-identity; MUST add a host test that drives sender identity through the sockaddr extraction path. U/L bit semantics per spec 6.2/RFC 4291.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-09-09T01:19:40.543810654Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-09-09T01:19:40.543810654Z","labels":["gateway"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-jzx5","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-utw0","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-09-09T01:19:40.666581376Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}

new_value: Fixed: the flip was the bug. tunnel_auth_post now hands receive() the canonical pubkey IID carried unflipped in the source link-local, via new shared helper lichen_tunnel_sender_iid_from_sockaddr() (tunnel_auth.c:378-391, host+Zephyr compilable); coap_server.c:644-656 calls it and no longer applies lichen_eui64_to_iid (the OSCORE ctx store's wire-EUI64 space stays unchanged - correct there). Orphaned ipv6_addr.h include removed from coap_server.c. Verification: host tunnel_auth suite green under ASan/UBSan incl. NEW test_sender_iid_from_sockaddr driving the real extraction path (canonical->204 allowed; U/L-flipped->WRONG_ROOT; 4x -EINVAL fail-closed). 3x delegated kimi-k3 reviews (correctness/security/edge): all PASS, zero findings. NOTE: Zephyr-config compile of the tunnel-auth path remains blocked by P2 gyfs (BUILD_ASSERT CREATED vs CHANGED at coap_server.c:613) - fix that next to unlock native_sim verification.
